Q Bistro · WIA2001-Database

User requirements

What the system must do

Maintain

  • Orders from QR and staff
  • Repeat QR scans in one bill
  • Special food requests
  • Staff records and ratings
  • Menu items and stalls
  • HQ seasonal promotions
  • Discount rules (10% / 20%)
  • Payments, all methods
  • Daily food wastage logs

Search

  • Active orders by table or order ID
  • Menu by code, type or stall
  • Staff by ID, role or ratingSupervisor
  • Receipts and HQ settlementManager

Track

  • Order status: complete, paid, cancelled
  • Cancellations and reasons
  • Daily wastage per menu item
  • 6-month reviews and rating history

Report

  • Daily and monthly sales
  • Food wastage
  • Staff performance ratings
  • Top-selling items
  • Discount audit
